Contact & support

My Little Pet is developed and supported by Teja Priyan, India.

Email support

teja1616150@gmail.com

For download, installation or gameplay help, include your edition, device, operating-system version and a short description of what happened. A screenshot of the error can help.

Please do not send passwords, payment credentials, Aadhaar/PAN documents or private recovery codes. Remove personal information from screenshots and save files.

Payments and orders

Plus is coming soon. We are not accepting payments or pre-orders on littlepet.in. If you see an unexpected charge claiming to be from this website, contact us with the date, amount and merchant description, without sharing full card or bank details.

Privacy enquiries

Use the same email to request access to or deletion of information you sent to support. Device-local pet saves can be managed on your own device as described in the privacy policy.
